scope: Numerical comparisons execute SciPy/statsmodels independently of the JavaScript implementation. Assertion counts overlap and are not independent validations.
Standalone browser checks execute actual Blob workers, real Plotly and native exports in a controlled about:blank fixture. Address-based Chromium navigation was blocked.
HTTP MIME/byte tests are separate from browser execution. Full hosted-module-worker, cross-lab navigation and physical-device acceptance are not certified.
Legacy 59-page-state accessibility audit is historical baseline evidence, not a fresh WCAG assessment.
No biological calibration or proof of feasibility/optimality for arbitrary models is asserted.
